panels.description: FALCON maintenance room. Sitara and Nayah stand beside a directional borehole map; unauthorized branches descend toward resource markers. Leave upper-left clear.

A physical manifest beside a concealed waste chute shows ICE CORE STORAGE overwriting DRILL FLUID / RESIDUALS. Nayah photographs it. Reserve a separate upper-left balloon zone for Nayah and upper-right balloon zone for Sitara, with a clear central gap.
Two synchronized displays show drilling vibration below and ice-motion plots above. A red timestamp fragment crosses the maintenance sheet. Leave top clear.
The TJ turns toward a sealed archive slot containing paper records, a dead data wafer, and the warning fragment. Leave upper-right clear.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: That is not an ice-core manifest.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: It is pretending to be one.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: The vibration is local. The instability is not.
